title: 真实分片词频评分差异：相同目标内容比较本地统计与DFS全局统计
body:
## 操作任务
实现compare(request,index,ids)。同一size100查询bool.must match(message=rare)、filter ids，依次POST index/_search?search_type=query_then_fetch与dfs_query_then_fetch；HTTP非200/timed_out/分片failed抛RuntimeError。返回{local:{id:实际_score},global:{id:实际_score}}，不归一化伪造分数、不改语料和输入。两个目标message相同，分别在rare频率1/20与20/20的真实物理分片，本地得分不同、DFS全局得分相同。

import os,sys,pathlib,json,copy,time,math
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def hits(server,index,body=None):return call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000&track_total_hits=true',body)['hits']['hits']
def routes(server,index):
 def shard(route):return call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_search_shards?routing='+route)['shards'][0][0]['shard']
 first='tenant0';second=next('tenant'+str(i) for i in range(1,50) if shard('tenant'+str(i))!=shard(first));return first,second
def bulk(server,index,events):
 lines=[]
 for docid,route,body in events:lines.extend([json.dumps({'index':{'_index':index,'_id':docid,'routing':route}}),json.dumps(body)])
 status,value=server.request('POST','/_bulk?refresh=true','\n'.join(lines)+'\n',content_type='application/x-ndjson');assert status==200 and not value['errors'],(status,value)
with Elasticsearch() as server:
 index='score_statistics';call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':2,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'properties':{'message':{'type':'text'}}}})
 first,second=routes(server,index);events=[('target-a',first,{'message':'rare'}),('target-b',second,{'message':'rare'})]
 for i in range(19):events.extend([('noise-a-'+str(i),first,{'message':'other'}),('noise-b-'+str(i),second,{'message':'rare'})])
 bulk(server,index,events);before={row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in hits(server,index)};ids=['target-a','target-b'];original=copy.deepcopy(ids)
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_TWO_SHARDS_IDENTICAL_TARGETS_DOCUMENT_FREQUENCY_1_OF20_VS20_OF20',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_local_vs_dfs_statistics_same_query_and_corpus',flush=True)
 calls=[]
 def request(method,path,body=None,**kwargs):calls.append((method,path,copy.deepcopy(body)));return server.request(method,path,body,**kwargs)
 try:result=task.compare(request,index,ids)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual scoring comparison failed') from error
 assert set(result)=={'local','global'} and all(set(value)==set(ids) for value in result.values())
 assert result['local']['target-a']>result['local']['target-b']*5,'local term statistics did not differ'
 assert math.isclose(result['global']['target-a'],result['global']['target-b'],rel_tol=1e-6),'DFS did not equalize identical terms under same global corpus'
 assert result['global']['target-a']>0 and len(calls)==2 and calls[0][2]==calls[1][2]
 assert 'search_type=query_then_fetch' in calls[0][1] and 'search_type=dfs_query_then_fetch' in calls[1][1]
 assert {row['_id']:row['_source'] for row in hits(server,index)}==before and ids==original
 print('NATIVE_LOCAL_AND_DFS_SCORE_OBSERVATIONS '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 print('NATIVE_SCORE_CONTENT_IDENTICAL_GLOBAL_STATS_EQUAL_LOCAL_STATS_DIFFER_NO_DATA_CHANGE',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

title: 真实命中下界与完整计数：gte标签、精确eq及HTTP200部分分片失败

title: 真实PIT检查点续传：并发更新删除后仍取旧快照，失效上下文不偷开新视图
body:
## 操作任务
实现resume(request,pit_id,after=None)。只POST /_search，size2、track_total_hits=false、match_all、pit keep_alive=1m，sort=[at asc,_shard_doc asc]，有after则原样search_after；每次使用最新pit_id继续，非200/timed_out/failed抛RuntimeError，最多1000页。空页成功返回{rows:[{id,source,sort}],pages:[{count,first,last}],complete:true,original_pit:传入pit}；finally DELETE /_pit释放最新ID。不得创建新PIT或换排序/查询，不改after。实际两主分片、同排序值、已有两条检查点后并发删/改/新增，续页与前页合并必须完整原7条各一次；已关闭PIT必须RuntimeError且不新建视图。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7两主分片PIT、search_after检查点、并发可见更新删除插入及实际关闭上下文后的404；显式关闭验证失效拒绝路径，不把它声称自然时钟到期或客户端崩溃持久化测试。仅固定match_all排序合同，不证明生产权限或长期磁盘容量。
